reviews.review:
(Note:  I am unable to change the Main Character's name.  Like at all.  No matter what you type?  It changes it into "Yui" for me.  I don't really mind, but for people who like to put in custom names...  That and at one point Oliver says "right, NAME?"  I thought it was hilarious!  XD)

-My review will be based off making "kind choices", as this is the way I like to play.-

Now then...:

I wanted sweet.  I wanted a cute romance.  Did this fulfill that...?  Actually?  Hell yeah!!

I mean it's short and you may get a craving for more, but it delivers.

We get two male Love Interests: Dane and Oliver.  While the other games usually split routes for LI most of the time, in this one you can interact with both, hanging out with one guy, then the other.  (It's linear in this case).  There are options and they are NOT HARD to figure out (and YES!  YOU CAN try and please both guys at the same time lol).  I think I was only uncertain about one option and even then...  I am not sure the game penalizes you for it.

The last question is the most important one: "Which one do you choose?"  Save and see both ends...  Which is the only time you'll get a CG per choice.  (They are pretty lovely and sweet.  :>)

OH!  And there is a DOGGO!  Can't forget that!  Heh heh.

Mm yeah...  That's pretty much it.

I am more than keeping this one.  I like it.  ^-^
